stem: Which of these is an example of a successful innovation of the assembly-line production model?

options.label: F
options.text: A social-media company initiates a new privacy policy for its subscribers.

options.label: G
options.text: A financial adviser redistributes money throughout a customer’s portfolio.

options.label: H
options.text: A computer is built to a purchaser’s specifications using the available inventory of supplies.

options.label: J
options.text: A cable-television company updates its system to include more channels.
